formula: delta chi = -integral [phi^2 delta v + (phi prime)^2 delta p] dr
definitions: p=r^2 N sqrt(f), v=4pi G beta r^2 N (e-3P)/(c^4 sqrt(f)); phi(infinity)=1.
normalized_variation: At fixed phi_infinity: delta alpha_A=-phi_infinity*(delta chi/M-chi*delta M/M^2).
boundary: Fixed areal radial coordinate with exterior included. Smooth perturbations, or distributional moving interfaces with their boundary terms retained. Asymptotic delta p=O(r), delta phi=O(1/r) makes the boundary correction vanish. The numerical shapes have compact support; no Einstein constraint satisfaction is asserted.
